title: OpenChoreo ObservabilityAlertRule
description: ObservabilityAlertRule is the Schema for the observabilityalertrules API.

spec.description: ObservabilityAlertRuleSpec defines the desired state of ObservabilityAlertRule.

actions.description: Actions defines the actions to take when the alert rule is triggered.

incident.description: Incident defines the incident to trigger when the alert rule is triggered.

enabled.description: Enabled toggles whether an incident should be triggered when the alert rule is triggered.

triggerAiCostAnalysis.description:
TriggerAiCostAnalysis toggles whether an AI cost analysis should be triggered when an incident is created.
To set this to true, Enabled must also be set to true.

triggerAiRca.description:
TriggerAiRca toggles whether an AI root cause analysis should be triggered when an incident is created.
To set this to true, Enabled must also be set to true.

notifications.description: Notifications defines the notifications to send when the alert rule is triggered.

channels.description: Channels defines the channels to send notifications to.

items.description: NotificationChannelName defines a non-empty notification channel identifier.

condition.description: Condition controls how the rule should be evaluated against the source.

interval.description: Interval dictates how often the alert rule is evaluated.

operator.description: Operator describes the comparison used when evaluating the threshold.

threshold.description: Threshold is the trigger value for the configured operator.

window.description: Window is the time window that is aggregated before a comparison is made.

description.description: Description is a human-friendly summary of the alert rule.

enabled.description: Enabled toggles whether this alert rule should be evaluated.

name.description: Name identifies the alert rule when defined as a Trait.

severity.description: Severity describes how urgent the alert is.

source.description: Source specifies the origin and query that drives the rule.

metric.description:
Metric specifies the metric to alert on.
This is required for metric-based alerting.

query.description:
Query defines the query or filter to locate relevant events.
This is required for log-based alerting.

type.description: Type specifies the telemetry source type (log, metric).
